[--acknowledge-network-review]
                      [{plan,create-change-set,execute}]

Plan, create, and explicitly execute a portable-demo CloudFormation change
set.

positional arguments:
  {plan,create-change-set,execute}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --parameters PARAMETERS
                        Native CloudFormation ParameterKey/ParameterValue JSON
                        list.
  --stack-name STACK_NAME
  --region REGION
  --profile PROFILE
  --apply               Permit the selected CloudFormation mutation; plan is
                        always read-only.
  --change-set CHANGE_SET
                        Full ARN required for execute.
  --allow-replacement   Explicitly permit reviewed removal/conditional
                        replacement on execute.
  --acknowledge-network-review
                        Acknowledge unresolved route coverage or restricted
                        destination warnings after network review.

S CLI credential
chain. No credentials or SSH keys are copied, printed, or rewritten.

positional arguments:
  {status,start,stop,update-my-ip,cleanup-plan,local-client-rollback}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --apply               perform the selected reversible operation
  --dry-run             show the plan only (default)
  --offline             use saved receipts; no AWS or public-IP requests;
                        cannot apply
  --client-ip CLIENT_IP
                        single client IPv4 as seen by EC2; required for
                        private routing, otherwise discover public egress
  --config CONFIG       machine configuration JSON; alternatively set
                        KIRO_DEMO_CONFIG
  --evidence-dir EVIDENCE_DIR
                        offline receipt directory override; only valid with
                        --offline
  --profile PROFILE     existing AWS CLI profile (credentials are never
                        copied)

usage: demo-telemetry.py [-h] [--apply] [--config CONFIG]
                         {collect-once,setup,stop}

Collect bounded client metrics for the demo. All changes require --apply. This
is a custom demo collector, separate from KiroCrew product analytics. Read-
only collection never reads command arguments, environment, or app state.

positional arguments:
  {collect-once,setup,stop}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --apply               Upload once, activate, or stop the client timer.
  --config CONFIG       Deployment JSON; defaults to KIRO_DEMO_CONFIG when
                        set.

usage: ec2-login.py [-h] [--config CONFIG] [--timeout SECONDS]

Fresh Kiro CLI 2.21.4 sign-in on EC2 through a local SSH callback tunnel. Uses
only Python's standard library, the existing strict SSH alias, and lsof. The
browser URL is printed to a terminal; tokens and account email are not shown.

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG    Explicit deployment JSON; or set KIRO_DEMO_CONFIG
  --timeout SECONDS  maximum sign-in duration, 60–3600 seconds (default: 900)

usage: serve-demo-probes.py [-h] [--config CONFIG]

Loopback-only operator screen for two fixed, bounded demo commands. This is a
recording aid, not KiroCrew's native interface. Starting this server does not
run either command. The operator must press a same-origin UI button. Only
schema-checked probe receipts / synthetic step rows are retained or served.

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG  Explicit deployment JSON; or set KIRO_DEMO_CONFIG

usage: demo-clips.py [-h] [--output OUTPUT] [--check] [--width WIDTH] [--webm]
                     [--audio]
                     manifest

Build evidence-preserving HTML demo media from reviewed cuts of local
recordings.

positional arguments:
  manifest         Reviewed JSON manifest; raw paths are relative to its
                   directory

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT  New output directory (never overwritten)
  --check          Validate input, timing, and cues without encoding
  --width WIDTH    Maximum video width; no upscaling (default 1600)
  --webm           Also encode VP9 WebM
  --audio          Include source audio; default is silent

usage: run-deck-council.py [-h] {prepare,run,assess} ...

Freeze and review one deck with the two explicitly requested local clients.
`prepare` never starts a reviewer. `run` requires the prepared manifest hash.
Authentication stays in each product; cloud/API credentials are not inherited.

positional arguments:
  {prepare,run,assess}
    prepare             freeze packet only; never call models
    run                 call both exact reviewers once for a confirmed
                        prepared packet
    assess              reconcile completed raw evidence only; never call
                        models
